children: President Donald Trump said on Monday that Canada-based airplane maker Bombardier
would no longer be allowed to sell in the United States unless it started manufacturing in the country.
"NO MORE SELLING BOMBARDIER IN THE UNITED STATES! Their products aren’t good enough!" Trump said in a post on Truth Social.
"If they want our Market, they must build here, and stop treating America like a “piggybank,” he said.
Canada and the United States have been locked in a trade dispute.
